title: Sub Registrar, Assistant Tribal Development Officer, Social Welfare Inspector, Office Superintendent, Office Assistant, Head Clerk, Senior Clerk and Junior Clerk
qualification: The prescribed degree must be obtained from a university established or incorporated under the applicable Central or State legislation, a recognized institution or an institution meeting the relevant University Grants Commission provisions.
salary: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary ranging from Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 49,600 for the first five years , depending on the post.
age_limit: Applicants must be at least 20 years old and not more than 35 years old as on 30 November 2026 , before any applicable upper-age relaxation.
application_fee: The preliminary examination fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for eligible reserved or concession categories . The notification states that examination fees will be refunded to candidates who appear for the examination. || Fee Payment Last Date: 2 December 2026, 11:59 PM. || Payment Mode: Online using Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through OJAS. Additional transaction charges may apply.
selection_process: The recruitment follows a two-stage competitive examination process: a common preliminary examination and separate main examinations for Group-A and Group-B. || Online Application:Candidates register and submit the application through OJAS. || Preliminary Examination:A common 150-mark objective examination is conducted for Group-A and Group-B. || Shortlisting for Mains:Separate Group-A and Group-B eligibility lists are prepared based on preliminary examination performance. || Main Examination:Group-A candidates appear for descriptive papers, while Group-B candidates appear for an objective main examination. || Document Verification:Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational, age, category and other eligibility conditions.

title: Apprentice - Various Trades
qualification: Important Eligibility Conditions: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification from a recognized institution. Applicants should not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently pursuing apprenticeship training are not eligible under the notification's conditions. Additional restrictions apply to Technician Apprentices with one year or more of relevant post-qualification training or work experience.
salary: The ONGC Apprentice salary per month ranges from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on the apprentice category and educational qualification. These amounts are monthly training stipends rather than permanent employee salaries. || Note: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months. ONGC will not reimburse transportation, boarding, or lodging expenses during training. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment in ONGC.
age_limit: The notification specifies the general eligible date-of-birth range as 29 November 2002 to 29 November 2008.
selection_process: Applications will be received through the NAPS and NATS portals. || ONGC will verify the eligibility and qualifications of applicants. || A provisional merit list will be prepared based on qualifying examination marks. || Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. || The final merit list will be prepared after verification and application of the relevant reservation rules. || Selected candidates must complete the required apprenticeship engagement formalities.

title: Apprentice
salary: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend at the rate prescribed by the Government for the applicable apprenticeship training. || The advertisement does not mention a fixed monthly stipend amount for individual trades. This is apprenticeship training, and the stipend should not be treated as a regular municipal employee salary.
age_limit: The uploaded apprenticeship advertisement does not separately specify a minimum age, maximum age or age-calculation date. || Candidates should refer to the applicable Apprentices Act provisions and the eligibility instructions on the current RMC application portal before applying.
application_fee: The uploaded advertisement does not specify an application fee or a separate payment procedure. || Candidates should follow the fee-related instructions, if any, displayed on the official RMC recruitment portal.
selection_process: Selection for the 825 Apprentice positions will be conducted based on merit among eligible candidates , according to the vacancies available in the respective trades. || Online Application:Candidates must submit the prescribed application form through the RMC website. || Document Submission:Applicants must submit the printed form and required self-attested documents at the designated office. || Eligibility Verification:RMC will verify the relevant ITI qualification and other prescribed conditions. || Merit-Based Selection:Eligible applicants will be considered in merit order against the available apprenticeship positions. || Waiting List:RMC may operate a merit-based waiting list to fill positions becoming vacant from time to time. || The advertisement does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. It also does not specify a numerical merit calculation formula.

title: Surveyor, Class-3
qualification: Important: Candidates with a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering are not eligible under the exclusion stated in the official recruitment rules. Applicants should not assume that having a higher Civil Engineering qualification overrides this restriction.
salary: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 26,000 for the first five years , subject to the conditions prescribed by the Gujarat Government. || After satisfactory completion of five years of service, candidates may become eligible for regular appointment in Pay Level 4, subject to the applicable Government resolutions, service conditions and pending judicial decisions specified in the notification.
age_limit: The age limit is 18 to 33 years as on 20 November 2026 , with applicable relaxation for eligible categories under Gujarat Government rules.
application_fee: The application fee is Rs. 500 for Unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for eligible concessional categories . The examination fee is refundable to candidates who appear in the competitive examination, subject to the conditions stated in the advertisement. || Fee Payment Deadline: 23 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
selection_process: Selection will be based on a single-stage competitive MCQ examination conducted through CBRT or OMR mode, followed by document verification and preparation of the selection and waiting lists. Appointed candidates must also satisfy the physical and walking-test requirements. || Competitive Examination - MCQ-based CBRT or OMR examination. || Document Verification of eligible shortlisted candidates. || Preparation of Selection List and Waiting List. || Physical Eligibility and Walking Test at the appointment stage. || Candidates must meet the minimum qualifying standard separately in both examination parts. Approximately twice the number of category-wise vacancies may be called for document verification, subject to the Board's recruitment procedure.

last_date: Graduate, Post Graduate, B.Sc, B.Tech/B.E, BDS, Diploma, GNM, M.Phil/Ph.D, MBBS, MS/MD
age_limit: Varies by post - see the table below
application_fee: Payment mode: Online Payment of Fee via Net Banking or Other Payment Mode on OJAS portal. Last date to pay the fee: 18 November 2026.

title: Food Safety Officer, Class-3
qualification: (i) A Master's Degree in Chemistry; or (ii) a degree in Food Technology, Diary Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agriculture Science, Veterinary Science, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology or Medicine. In both cases the degree must meet the university conditions given below the table.
salary: For the first five years, appointment is on the fixed pay of Rs. 40,800 per month and the other benefits under the Finance Department resolutions. The latest of these is the resolution dated 18/10/2023 (No. Kharch-2002-57-(Part-4)-Z.1). If service is found satisfactory at the end of five years, the candidate becomes eligible for regular appointment in the Level-5 pay scale. This is subject to the General Administration Department resolution dated 23/10/2015 and the Finance Department resolutions dated 28/03/2016 and 18/01/2017. It is also subject to the Supreme Court's decision in SLP No.14124/2012 and SLP No.14125/2012.
age_limit: On 10/11/2026, candidates must be at least 18 years old and not more than 37 years old. Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may get a relaxation of the upper age limit under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967.
application_fee: The fee is paid online only, after the application is submitted and a confirmation number is generated, by13/11/2026 (23:59 hours). No other mode is accepted, and no late fee is accepted. || Payment can be made by Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallets. Go to the Online Application tab on OJAS, then Print Application Form / Pay Fees, then Online Payment of Fees. The transaction charge is paid on top of the fee. || Candidates must keep a printout of the fee receipt or the e-receipt. If no receipt is generated, the fee is not treated as paid. The receipt can be printed again through Print Application Form / Pay Fees, then Online Payment Receipt. || The fee is refunded, through the mode used to pay it, to candidates who appear in the examination. Candidates who do not appear get no refund. This is why the bank account details asked for in the form matter. || An application without the fee is rejected without notice. The fee is not refunded if the Board rejects an application.
selection_process: One-stage MCQ competitive examination (CBRT or OMR), with Part-A and Part-B in a single question paper. || Document verification for about two times the number of posts in each category, chosen by total marks from among candidates who meet the qualifying standard in both parts. If enough candidates are not available after this, more candidates from the provisional merit list may be called by category. || Selection list, and a waiting list where applicable, prepared by category on merit (General Administration Department resolution dated 27/07/2018). || The Board recommends the selected candidates to the department concerned for appointment, in order of Merit Number. || Widows:Widow candidates get 5% of their CBRT/OMR marks added for preference in selection. They must not have remarried at the time of appointment and must produce proof in original. A woman who becomes a widow after applying gets the benefit from the stage of the process still remaining after she submits proof. || Sportspersons:Candidates who have represented in (i) national or international, (ii) inter-university or (iii) All India School Federation competitions get 5% of their marks added. This applies to these sports: Athletics (including track and field), Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Tennis, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Archery, Horse riding, Shot put, Rowing, Chess and Handball. A certificate in the prescribed format from the authorised officer is needed at document verification. If it is found later that the certificate is not valid, the extra 5% is withdrawn and the merit is worked out again.
